instruction: Look at cross_rest_pocket.step in NX CAM. Rough the cross_rest_pocket.step pocket first with T1 using Pocket Milling or Cavity Mill. Then use T2 for Rest Milling to clear inside corners and narrow leftover regions. The pocket floor target is Z=8.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 12 mm end mill for rough pocket clearing; T2 is a 4 mm end mill for Rest Milling. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-9.nc.
